Big Buck Hunter Pro.name: Big Buck Hunter Pro
Big Buck Hunter Pro.summary: Big Buck Hunter PRO is a new species of hunting game that delivers a hot new quarry of no-limit fun to players everywhere. The premise is simple; There are 4 areas with 5 rounds in each one. Each round has 3 bucks to take down with your shotgun, but watch out for those doe's, other wise the round is over

Rio.name: Rio
Rio.summary: A multiplayer party game that takes place in the world of Rio, and allows up to four players to compete in minigames taking place in the various movie locations. The original voice cast reprises their roles for all the characters.

Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell - Double Agen.name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Double Agent
Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell - Double Agen.summary: In the highly anticipated sequel, Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Double Agent, play as a double agent spy for the first time ever. Take on dual roles of covert operative and ruthless terrorist, where your choices of whom to betray and whom to protect actually affect the outcome of your game. This is the Ubisoft Montreal version, which plays more like the classic Splinter Cell games. The games share the same general plot but feature different storylines, plot twists, and levels. They do however, share the same background music, a few cut scenes and all voice actors.
